name: Meta Words
body:
Name	Description
Boost	Allows an effect or target word to use its boosted description.
Careful	A wordspell with this meta word does not require a somatic component.
Distant	This word increases a wordspell’s range.
Irresistible	Targets of a wordspell with this meta word must roll their saving throws twice and take the worse result.
Lengthy	A wordspell with this meta word doubles its duration.
Manifestation	This word changes the saving throw type of certain effect words used in this spell.
Mind Warp	This word changes the saving throw type of certain effect words used in this spell.
Penetrating	The caster of a wordspell containing this meta word can roll twice to overcome any spell resistance the targets might possess, taking the better result.
Quiet	A wordspell with this meta word does not require a verbal component.
Simple	A wordspell with this meta word does not require a material component.
